assertions.name: zeta_reg_improves_over_li2q
assertions.source: Zeta-regularized bar-pair gives m_p = 21.7172 MeV, a 3.178× improvement over the production Li_2^q tower's 6.83288 MeV.  Pass iff improvement > 2×.

assertions.name: zeta_reg_bounded_between_li2q_and_phi_q
assertions.source: The bar-pair Archimedean realization should sit between the Li_2^q value (137× too small) and the Φ_q value (642× too big). This structural ordering validates the regularization scheme.

description: Tests Route (b) closure for the proton mass-formula gap via zeta-regularization of log Φ_{q⁻¹}(V) at |V| > q⁻¹.  The regularized bar-pair Archimedean realization gives m_p ≈ 21.75 MeV — a 3× improvement over the pre-Archim Li_2^q tower (6.83 MeV) but still 43× off CODATA.  Confirms direction of Route (b) but not full closure.  See docs/audits/2026-05-25-gap-closure-structural-analysis.md for the framing.
